title: Evidence-backed RossFast solver admissibility matrix

semantics.ROSSFAST_ADMISSIBLE: The complete requested solver use is qualified for the stated envelope. No current row has this status yet.
semantics.ROSSFAST_NOT_YET_QUALIFIED: The combination is architecturally or physically eligible for research but one or more required qualification gates remain open or have failed for the tested representation.
semantics.ROSSFAST_NOT_SUPPORTED: A deliberate canonical-product or architecture exclusion backed by evidence. This status is not inferred merely from missing evidence or a failed candidate representation.
semantics.fallback_rule: Any requested production combination that is not ROSSFAST_ADMISSIBLE must use an explicitly selected qualified alternative without silently changing requested physics. If the requested physical composition itself is NOT_SUPPORTED, solver fallback does not make it canonical; exact historical reproduction requires an explicitly named legacy-compatibility route.

rows.fallback_physics_rule: Retain exact KSATEXM and use FullRichards or another separately qualified solver.

rows.scope_note: H_ENPR alone is a source-defined finite-air-entry modified-MvG family. It must not inherit C1R or C2A qualification and must not be conflated with active legacy KSATEXM.

rows.evidence_summary: 108/108 diagnostic cases were discontinuous and had a downward K jump when KSATEXM activated after H_ENPR changed theta(h).
rows.canonical_policy: Do not expose as an ordinary composable SWAP5 hydraulic configuration.
rows.legacy_compatibility_rule: Exact historical behavior may be reproduced only through an explicitly named legacy-compatibility mode with diagnostics. Solver fallback is not a repair for this physical branch mismatch.
rows.replacement_rule: Use a separately defined continuous physical near-saturation closure if H_ENPR-like finite air entry and measured saturated conductivity are both desired.

rows.scope_note: No silent disabling or folding of explicit macropore physics into a matrix conductivity closure is allowed.

rows.architecture_note: Shared immutable tables and zero per-column table state are compatible with MultiSWAP but do not constitute a performance qualification.

rows.required_reference: FullRichards must use the identical closure before solver-equivalence qualification.
rows.parameter_note: A faithful published-MMVG candidate retains its own fitted K_o and L semantics; it must not be declared equivalent to legacy SWAP parameters without an explicit mapping contract.

rows.required_reference: The same closure must be callable by FullRichards before any RossFast equivalence claim.
rows.identity_guard: This is neither exact SWAP431 KSATEXM nor verbatim published MMVG2006 nor the unresolved NHI conservative variant.

rows.scope_note: Conceptual lineage is relevant but must remain separate from the published MMVG formulation until the exact implementation is recovered.
No permanent NOT_SUPPORTED decision is made yet; a physical double-counting analysis is required first.

next_update_trigger: Update a row only when a separately frozen qualification gate changes its evidence state; do not infer admission from adjacent rows or similar parameter values.
